npc.example_merchant.greeting: [EN] Hello %s! Welcome to my shop. Say {trade} to see my offers.
npc.example_merchant.help: [EN] I can sell you potions, weapons and armor. Say {trade} to browse my goods.
npc.example_merchant.job: [EN] I am a merchant. I sell various goods to adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.low_level: [EN] Sorry, but you are too inexperienced. Come back when you reach level 8.
npc.example_merchant.name: [EN] My name is Marcus. I run this shop.
npc.example_merchant.news_1: [EN] Have you heard? Dragons were spotted near the mountains!
npc.example_merchant.news_2: [EN] The king is looking for brave adventurers.
npc.example_merchant.trade: [EN] Of course! Here are my offers.
